# Astrophysics and Supernovae

Massive stars end their life cycles through catastrophic core-collapse events known as core-collapse supernovae (Type II).

## High-Energy Explosion Dynamics

When iron core mass exceeds the Chandrasekhar limit ($M \approx 1.44 M_\odot$), electron degeneracy pressure collapses. The resulting shockwave unleashes a cosmic `SUPERNOVA-BURST` with total emitted energy exceeding:

$$
E_{\text{total}} \approx 10^{44} \text{ J}
$$

The optical signature of a `SUPERNOVA-BURST` outshines entire galaxies for days.
